toolDetails.Portainer: Portainer is a centralized container management platform. It provides a visual interface for managing Docker environments, orchestration, and monitoring containerized applications.
toolDetails.Docker: Docker is the world’s leading containerization platform. It enables developers to package applications into standardized units called containers, ensuring consistency across development, testing, and production.
toolDetails.Harbor: Harbor is an open-source trusted cloud-native registry project that stores, signs, and scans content. It provides security, identity, and management across your container image lifecycle.
toolDetails.Jenkins: Jenkins is an open-source automation server which enables developers around the world to reliably build, test, and deploy their software.
toolDetails.Timeshift: Timeshift for Linux is an application that provides functionality similar to the System Restore feature in Windows and the Time Machine tool in macOS.
toolDetails.Ollama: Ollama allows you to run open-source large language models, such as Llama 3, locally on your machine with a simple setup.
toolDetails.Rkhunter: Rootkit Hunter (RKH) is a Unix-based tool that scans for rootkits, backdoors, and possible local exploits by comparing SHA-1 hashes of important files with known good ones.
toolDetails.Nvidia-CUDA: CUDA is a parallel computing platform and programming model developed by NVIDIA for general computing on graphical processing units (GPUs).
toolDetails.AMD ROCm: ROCm is an open-source software stack for GPU computing, designed for performance and efficiency on AMD Radeon and Instinct GPUs.
toolDetails.Grafana: Grafana is the open-source analytics & monitoring solution for every database. It allows you to query, visualize, alert on and understand your metrics no matter where they are stored.
toolDetails.InfluxDB: InfluxDB is an open-source time series database developed by InfluxData. It is optimized for fast, high-availability storage and retrieval of time-series data.
toolDetails.PostgreSQL: PostgreSQL is a powerful, open-source object-relational database system that uses and extends the SQL language combined with many features that safely store and scale the most complicated data workloads.
toolDetails.NMap: Nmap (Network Mapper) is a free and open-source utility for network discovery and security auditing. It is used to discover hosts and services on a computer network by sending packets and analyzing the responses.
